escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over two hundred and ninety-eight million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, with the weekly cut every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. In position number ten, from Türkiye, Voile Diy, with “He Fell Through the Rotten Porch So I Built This!”. Over eight point eight million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-eight thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty seconds.

In position number nine, from Finland, Brawl Stars, with “Gus's Origin Story! Brawl Stars Animation”. Over eight point eight million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and ninety thousand views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

At number eight, from Italy, maybewandy, with “audrey egged mary's house”. Over ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and sixty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixty seconds.

Next up, number seven, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong, with “Attempting to sail the most dangerous ocean in the world”. Over eleven million views. A video over seventy minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

In position number six, from France, Inoxtag, with a video posted three days ago. Over eleven million views. A video over one hundred and sixteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over nineteen thousand comments.
Coming in at number five, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Monkey Bars Under A 216m Bridge”. Over thirteen million views. A Short of just fifty-five seconds. It also has over five thousand comments.

Coming in at number four, from Cyprus, crafter duck - DIY, with a video posted six days ago. Over fourteen million views. A Short of just forty-one seconds. It also has two hundred and thirty comments.

Bronze medal, from Spain, Hasta Que Funcione, with a video posted four days ago. Over sixteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-six thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.
Silver medal, from Germany, Younes Zarou, with “Is this the end?”. Over sixteen million views. A Short of just twenty-four seconds. It also has five hundred and eighty-seven comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, JDBFOOTBALL, with “The art of tap ins”. Over seventeen million views. A Short of just twenty-four seconds. It also has nine hundred and thirty-three comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, from United Kingdom, Max Klymenko, with “His job is all about SPEAKING? Ep. 687”. Over four thousand comments. It also has over four point nine million views.
Coming in at number nine, FORMULA 1, with “Race Highlights 2026 Mexico City Grand Prix”. Over five thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over seven point five million views.
In position number eight, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Monkey Bars Under A 216m Bridge”. Over five thousand comments. A Short of just fifty-five seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.

Coming in at number seven, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted two days ago. Over six thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over nine hundred and thirty-seven thousand views.

Number six, from United Kingdom, Grian, with “Final Life: Episode 1 - HE'S BACK!”. Over nine thousand comments. A video over sixty-six minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over two point eight million views.

In position number five, Jazzghost, with a video posted six days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. A video over fifty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point nine million views.

At number four, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong, with “Attempting to sail the most dangerous ocean in the world”. Over fourteen thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A video over seventy minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Bronze medal, from Finland, Brawl Stars, with “Brawl Talk: Ranked Refresh, 3 New Brawlers and Traditional Brawlidays!”. Over seventeen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twenty-four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over seven point four million views.

Silver medal, from France, Inoxtag, with a video posted three days ago. Over nineteen thousand comments. A video over one hundred and sixteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eleven million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirty-five thousand comments. A video over one hundred and one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eight point one million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Number ten, from United Kingdom, The Diary Of A CEO, with a video posted five days ago. Over one hundred and sixty-three thousand likes. A video over one hundred and one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eight point one million views.

Next up, number nine, from Spain, Jajamaru, with a video posted six days ago. Over one hundred and seventy-four thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds. It also has over seven point seven million views.

In position number eight, Jazzghost, with a video posted six days ago. Over two hundred and thirteen thousand likes. A video over fifty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over five point nine million views.

In position number seven, from Italy, maybewandy, with “audrey egged mary's house”. Over three hundred and twenty thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and sixty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just sixty seconds.
At number six, from United Kingdom, Max Klymenko, with “His job is all about SPEAKING? Ep. 687”. Over three hundred and seventy-six thousand likes. It also has over four point nine million views.

Coming in at number five, from Austria, Red Bull, with “Monkey Bars Under A 216m Bridge”. Over three hundred and eighty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-five seconds. It also has over thirteen million views.

Next up, number four, from Spain, Hasta Que Funcione, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and ninety thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about twenty-six thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over sixteen million views.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong, with “Attempting to sail the most dangerous ocean in the world”. Over three hundred and ninety-four thousand likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one hundred and eighty thousand views per hour. A video over seventy minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Silver medal, from France, Inoxtag, with a video posted three days ago. Over four hundred and sixty thousand likes. A video over one hundred and sixteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over eleven million views.

And finally, number one most liked, from Finland, Brawl Stars, with “Brawl Talk: Ranked Refresh, 3 New Brawlers and Traditional Brawlidays!”. Over one point seven million likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twenty-four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over seven point four million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Europe every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
